$Comment: A second Disenchanting Table for a worker who has proven the first one earns its keep: a
hundred pieces unmade, then Life essence delivered.
volume counts pieces the tables took apart (STATION_INPUT, blank Target so any piece counts,
qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count and the Sawmill does not,
with the shared unmake_gear TextKey); bring_essence is Order 2, an exact-id hand-in to Orrin.
Life essence is the table's ordinary wage, so the delivery is paid for by running the table,
not by a detour. This quest branches off the chain after Three Kinds of Gear rather than
sitting in it, so it carries no Chains entry and its SortOrder places it after the chain's
rungs. The reward is the table itself; remove that entry and the quest is a plain XP job.
Name: A_Second_Table
